# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the source code. Do not edit; CI checks it. -->

The tools of the Hardless MCP server (`hardless mcp`, or `/mcp` on the server); see [Using Hardless from an AI agent](../agents.md). Every tool also has an output schema; receipt tools add a PNG image block.

## `create_device`

Create a device from a kind and config. Use to add a second printer, a USB printer or a drawer. Example: {"kind":"printer-escpos","id":"kitchen","config":{"paperWidth":58}}

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | any | none | Device config, e.g. `{ "transport": "usb" }` or `{ "attachedTo": "printer-1" }`. |
| `id` | string | none | Device ID; generated (`<kind>-<n>`) if left out. |
| `kind` | string | required | Device kind: `printer-escpos`, `cash-drawer`, `scanner-wedge` or `nfc-reader`. |

## `decode_escpos`

Decode ESC/POS bytes (hex or base64) into text, a PNG and an AST summary, without any device. Use to check bytes your code builds. Example: {"bytes":"1b40 48690a 1d5600"} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bytes` | string | required | ESC/POS bytes as hex (`1b 40 48 69 0a`) or base64. |
| `format` | `text` or `image` or `both` | none | `text`, `image` or `both` (default). |
| `width` | integer | none | Paper width, 58 or 80 mm (default 80). |

## `get_events`

Read a device's event log: bytes in and out (hex, with decoded ESC/POS commands), state changes, faults, scans and taps. Example: {"deviceId":"printer-1","limit":50} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The device. |
| `limit` | integer | none | Only the newest this many records (default 100). |
| `since` | integer | none | Only records after this `seq`. |

## `get_job`

Get one receipt by job ID as text, PNG and metadata, like get_last_receipt. Example: {"deviceId":"printer-1","jobId":3} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The printer. |
| `format` | `text` or `image` or `both` | none | `text`, `image` or `both` (default). |
| `jobId` | integer | required | The job ID from `list_jobs`. |
| `width` | integer | none | Paper width for the image, 58 or 80 mm. |

## `get_last_receipt`

Get a printer's latest receipt as text, a PNG image and job metadata. Use to check what the app printed. Example: {"deviceId":"printer-1","format":"both"} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The printer, e.g. `printer-1`. |
| `format` | `text` or `image` or `both` | none | `text`, `image` or `both` (default). |
| `width` | integer | none | Paper width for the image, 58 or 80 mm (default: the printer's). |

## `list_devices`

List every emulated device with its kind, state and active faults. Use first to learn device IDs. Example input: {} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## `list_faults`

List the fault catalogue with effects and options, optionally only a device kind's faults. Example: {"kind":"printer-escpos"} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string | none | Only faults a device kind supports, e.g. `printer-escpos`. |

## `list_jobs`

List a printer's receipts, newest first, with ID, time, first line and whether it was cut. Example: {"deviceId":"printer-1","limit":5} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The printer. |
| `limit` | integer | none | Most jobs to list (default 20). |

## `remove_device`

Remove a device with its receipts and event log. Use to clean up devices you created. Example: {"id":"kitchen"} Destructive.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required | The device ID, e.g. `printer-1`. |

## `reset_device`

Reset a device: clear its state, receipts and faults. Use before a test run for a clean start. Example: {"id":"printer-1"} Destructive.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | required | The device ID, e.g. `printer-1`. |

## `run_scenario`

Run a scenario: timed steps (scan, tap, wait, setFault, clearFault, expect) on the server's devices; returns step results. Example: {"steps":[{"type":"scan","device":"scanner-1","code":"123"}]}

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | none | A name for the report. |
| `steps` | array | required | Steps in order: `scan`, `tap`, `wait`, `setFault`, `clearFault`, `expect`, e.g. `{ "type": "scan", "device": "scanner-1", "code": "123" }`. |

## `scan_barcode`

Scan a barcode on a keyboard-wedge scanner: pages with the Hardless shim get the keys in the focused field. Example: {"deviceId":"scanner-1","code":"4006381333931"}

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | required | The barcode content. |
| `delayMs` | integer | none | Milliseconds between keys (default: the scanner's). |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The keyboard-wedge scanner, e.g. `scanner-1`. |
| `terminator` | string | none | Key after the code: `enter`, `tab` or `none` (default: the scanner's). |

## `set_fault`

Turn a fault on or off, e.g. paper-out, offline, read-error. Use to test the app's error handling. Example: {"deviceId":"printer-1","faultId":"paper-out","active":true}

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | boolean | required | On or off. |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The device. |
| `faultId` | string | required | The fault, e.g. `paper-out` (see `list_faults`). |
| `options` | object | none | Fault options, e.g. `{ "afterBytes": 32 }`. |

## `tap_nfc`

Tap an NFC card on a reader: pages scanning with NDEFReader get a reading. Example: {"deviceId":"nfc-1","uid":"04a2b3c4","records":[{"recordType":"text","data":"Member 1234"}]}

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The NFC reader, e.g. `nfc-1`. |
| `records` | array | none | NDEF records (Web NFC field names); without them the reader uses what it remembers. |
| `uid` | string | required | Card UID as hex, e.g. `04a2b3c4d5e6f7`. |

## `wait_for_job`

Wait for the next receipt a printer prints, then return it like get_last_receipt. Call before triggering a print. Example: {"deviceId":"printer-1","timeoutMs":10000} Read-only.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deviceId` | string | required | The printer. |
| `format` | `text` or `image` or `both` | none | `text`, `image` or `both` (default). |
| `timeoutMs` | integer | none | How long to wait in milliseconds (default 10000). |
| `width` | integer | none | Paper width for the image, 58 or 80 mm. |
